description: This file contains Alembic database migration scripts for updating and downgrading chart parameters related to old time comparison controls in the Superset project. It defines functions to upgrade/downgrade slice parameters, manipulate database entries, and includes class definitions for database models.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: Database model representing a chart slice with id, params, and viz_type fields.

methods.name: upgrade_comparison_params
methods.description: Transforms slice parameters to include new time comparison controls during upgrade.

methods.name: downgrade_comparison_params
methods.description: Reverts slice parameters to previous format, removing new time comparison controls during downgrade.
